title: Low Usage - Use Ramp Mode
visual_summary: Demonstrates pressing Ramp button on CPAP device to start therapy at lower initial pressure.
narration_summary: If the pressure feels too strong at first, try the ramp feature. So it starts low and increases gradually..

start_scene_0_3s.description: Shows patient struggling with high initial airflow pressure.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Pressing Ramp button on CPAP machine panel.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Pressure gradually increases while patient comfortably falls asleep.
